connectors.name: Linear
connectors.description: Manage Issues, projects, documents, and releases in Linear. Create and update issues with assignees and labels, comment and reply in threads, create projects with milestones and status updates, manage documents and attachments, view sprint cycles and team statuses, search and review PR diffs.
connectors.description_zh: 管理 Linear 中的 Issues、项目、文档和发布。支持创建和更新 Issue 并指派负责人与标签，评论与讨论串回复，创建项目和里程碑及进度报告，管理文档和附件，查看 Sprint 周期与团队状态，搜索和 Code Review PR 变更。
connectors.description_en: Manage Issues, projects, documents, and releases in Linear. Create and update issues with assignees and labels, comment and reply in threads, create projects with milestones and status updates, manage documents and attachments, view sprint cycles and team statuses, search and review PR diffs.
examples_zh: 在我的团队创建一个高优 Bug：「用户登录后页面白屏」，指派给我，打上 Bug 标签，关联到本周的 Sprint 周期
帮我把 ENG-42 这个 Issue 标记为已完成，然后添加一条评论说明修复方案，再创建一个子任务指派给 @李伟 跟进后续优化
创建一个名为「Q3 移动端改版」的项目，加入我的团队，设置下周五为目标日期，添加三个里程碑：设计稿交付、前端开发、集成测试
查一下我所有还未开始的 Issue，筛选出 Urgent 和 High 优先级的，按创建时间排列，顺便看下每条有没有人评论过
在项目「移动端改版」里新增一条状态更新，标题写「本周进度」，内容说明完成了登录模块和首页重构，剩下的支付模块推迟到下周
examples_en: In my team create a high-priority Bug titled 'Blank screen after login', assign to me, label as Bug, and add to the current sprint cycle
Mark issue ENG-42 as done, add a comment explaining the fix, and create a subtask assigned to @alex for follow-up optimization
Create a new project called 'Q3 Mobile Redesign' under my team, set target date to next Friday, with three milestones: Design Handoff, Frontend Dev, and Integration Testing
Find all my unstarted issues with Urgent or High priority, sorted by creation date, and check if any have comments on them
Add a status update to the 'Mobile Redesign' project titled 'This Week's Progress', noting login module and homepage refactor are done, payment module is pushed to next week

examples_en: Find all emails from hr@company.com in the past two weeks, sort by date, and tell me the total count and key topics

connectors.name: 企业微信

connectors.name: 企查查·法律数据
connectors.description: Search and verify Chinese statutes and judicial cases through natural language. Covers full in-force laws at both statute and article level with validity tagging, a massive body of judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases, and citation verification that eliminates fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content.
connectors.description_zh: 检索与核验中国法律法规和司法案例。覆盖全量现行法律、行政法规、司法解释——法规级到法条级逐字正文，标注时效性与效力级别；海量裁判文书及 2.5 万+ 权威案例（最高法/最高检指导性案例、公报案例、典型案例）；并对文本中的法条与案号引用逐条回库核验、标注时效、生成可溯源超链。用自然语言完成法条依据查找、类案检索、原文调取与法律引用核验，从源头消除法条与案号幻觉。
connectors.description_en: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.
